name: Potter County, TX
findings: Potter County has 353 nonprofit organizations. 150 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Potter County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
